High-grade Glioma; WHO Grade Ⅳ Glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] Anti-B7-H3 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell (CAR-T Cell) Injection/TX103

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Safety and Efficacy Study of TX103 CAR-T Cell Therapy for Recurrent or Progressive Grade 4 Glioma.

agents.agent_name_registered: Anti-B7-H3 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell (CAR-T Cell) Injection/TX103

role_evidence.quote: evaluate the safety, tolerability and antitumor activity of anti-B7-H3 CAR-T cell injection (TX103) in subjects with recurrent or progressive Grade 4 Glioma.

source_quote.quote: Subjects with confirmed B7-H3 positive\* (≥30%) tumor expression by immunohistochemistry (IHC) in either primary or recurrent tumor tissue.

coder_notes: CAR-T only trial: excluded intervention type, no pharmacological candidate. Glioblastoma named in inclusion criteria among grade 4 gliomas (grade 4 astrocytoma, diffuse hemispheric glioma also eligible) -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named. B7-H3 is an entry requirement matched to the CAR-T target, but the CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. NTRK/BRAF V600E mentioned only as prior-therapy history, not recorded as biomarkers. Three experimental arms (dose/route cohorts), none a control.
